narrationTexts: Confirmed. Fixing both call sites now.
finalText:
**Build is clean.** Two real bugs, not just log noise.

`options.retries` was still read after the bundler renamed that field to `retryCount`, so [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.

Second bug: the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, and [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) only handled `true`/`false`, throwing on `undefined`. Added an `undefined` case, treated as disabled.

`node build.js` now exits 0 with 8 warnings, all deprecation noise, no errors.

Next: nothing, build passes.
